readme:
# ThomasNet Scraper - US Industrial Supplier Directory

Extract supplier data from [ThomasNet](https://www.thomasnet.com), the largest US industrial supplier directory with 500,000+ manufacturers, distributors and service companies. Search by keyword and get one clean row per supplier with contact details, location, size and, optionally, the contact person, product families and certification counts from the profile page. No login required.

## How it works

The actor runs HTTP-only (no browser, 128 MB RAM). Each search query gets its own sticky proxy session: it opens the ThomasNet homepage first, then reads the first page of search results and, optionally, opens each supplier profile for the contact person, product families and certification counts. Rows are written to the dataset one by one as they are found, so a long run never loses data.

- **Up to ~27 suppliers per search query.** ThomasNet shows anonymous visitors only the first results page (the next page is a "Register to continue" login wall), so each query returns at most one page. Add several queries (for example by region, material or process) to get more suppliers.
- `maxResults` is a limit **per search query**; values above 27 are accepted but cannot yield more than one results page.
- A supplier that matches several queries is returned once; `search_query` shows which search found it first.
- Proxy handling is built in. There is no proxy setting to configure.
- If ThomasNet blocks every request, the run ends **FAILED** with a clear message instead of finishing empty.

## What data can you extract?

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` | ThomasNet supplier ID |
| `name` | Company name |
| `description` | Company description |
| `website` | Company website |
| `phone` | Main phone number |
| `address`, `city`, `state`, `postal_code` | Street address, city, state, ZIP code |
| `country`, `country_code` | Country name and ISO code (United States, Canada, Mexico) |
| `latitude`, `longitude` | GPS coordinates |
| `logo_url` | Company logo |
| `employee_count` | Employee range |
| `revenue` | Annual revenue range |
| `year_founded` | Year founded |
| `categories` | Product / service categories |
| `supplier_type` | Manufacturer, Distributor, Custom Manufacturer, Service Company, ... |
| `contact_name`, `contact_title` | First contact person listed on the profile page (flat fields for CSV export). Detail mode only. |
| `contact_persons` | All contact persons on the profile page, as `{name, title}`. Detail mode only. |
| `product_families` | Product and service families the supplier is listed under. Detail mode only. |
| `certification_counts` | Number of certifications per type, e.g. `{"quality": 2, "registration": 1}`. Counts only; the profile does not list individual certificates. Detail mode only. |
| `certifications_total` | Total number of certifications. Detail mode only. |
| `is_claimed` | Whether the supplier claimed its ThomasNet profile. Detail mode only. |
| `search_query` | The query (or search URL term) that found the supplier |
| `search_page` | Search result page the supplier was found on |
| `source_url` | ThomasNet profile URL |
| `source_platform` | Always `thomasnet.com` |
| `scraped_at` | Scrape timestamp (UTC) |

## Input options

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `searchQueries` | array | Keywords to search, e.g. "CNC machining". Each runs as its own search. |
| `searchUrls` | array | ThomasNet search URLs. Each runs as its own search. |
| `maxResults` | integer | Maximum suppliers **per query / URL** (default 25). A search yields at most ~27 suppliers (first results page only). |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | Fetch each profile page for contact persons, product families, certification counts and fuller company data (default true). |
| `maxConcurrency` | integer | Searches processed in parallel (default 3, max 10). |

With empty input the actor searches "steel fabrication".

## Example input

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["cnc machining", "injection molding"],
  "maxResults": 50,
  "includeDetails": true
}
```

## Pricing

Pay per event:

| Event | Price | When it is charged |
|-------|-------|--------------------|
| Run start | $0.005 | Once per run |
| Search result | $0.0015 | Per supplier returned from search data only |
| Profile result | $0.0035 | Per supplier returned with profile page data |

A supplier is billed once, right after its row is saved. If a profile page cannot be loaded, the supplier is returned from search data and billed as a search result.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, including Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain and LlamaIndex.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "apify": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "mcp-remote",
        "https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/thomasnet-scraper",
        "--header",
        "Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Example prompt: "Use `thomasnet-scraper` to find CNC machining suppliers and return a table with website, phone and city."

## Tips

- Use `searchQueries` for most cases. Each query returns up to ~27 suppliers (first results page); use several more specific queries to cover a market.
- The profile page has no email address (only a contact form). To get emails, feed the `website` field to the related actors below.
- Set `includeDetails` to `false` for large runs that only need search-level fields (name, phone, address, size, revenue, categories). It is faster and cheaper.
- ThomasNet sits behind DataDome. Occasional blocked pages are retried automatically with a fresh session; if a run still ends FAILED, try again later.

## Related actors

- [Website Email Scraper](https://console.apify.com/actors/VpLcKwzcl70CPHljg/information/latest/readme) - find emails on the supplier websites in the `website` field.
- [Website Contact Extractor](https://console.apify.com/actors/JmMPJ7zumUfB7p0Kr/information/latest/readme) - extract structured contact details from supplier websites.
